messages:
noah: Quick FYI: starting Sunflower-7B bring-up in staging. License has a clause disallowing redistribution of modified models. Does shipping quantized weights to customer appliances count as redistribution?

eva: Short answer: yes. If the customer gets artifacts that let them run offline, that's redistribution.

sam: What about a signed runtime that streams weights at install-time and doesn't leave our control? Is that a workaround?

mira-legal: Possibly, but we need explicit clarification from the Provider. Streaming+attestation can be acceptable if weights are not transferable, but we should ask for written permission.

pack-bot: Suggested mitigation: set `policy:hosted-only` and `registry:deny-export` for Sunflower-7B until clearance.

noah: Action plan: 1) set hosted-only, 2) run internal 4-bit/8-bit quant benches, 3) open T-5023 for legal outreach.

eva: Infra will add CI guard to block any exportable artifacts to public registry.

mira-legal: I'll draft an email requesting a limited sublicense to distribute quantized derivatives under a no-onward-redistribution covenant, and confirm whether signed installer pulls are permitted.

sam: Bench note for the ticket: 4-bit reduced memory ~55% and gave ~1.9x throughput with ~3% quality delta on our conv evals. We'll attach logs only.

noah: Thanks all. I'll update T-5023 with benches and the hosted-only tag. Close thread here.
